as_told.title: Researcher visits Doty-linked sources and 'takes the bait'

plain: This story is about a moment in 1982 when a man named Rick Doty, a figure well known in UFO circles, contacted a UFO researcher named Linda Moulton Howe. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says Doty showed her documents, including one about something called Project Garnet. A writer and guest on the show, Greg Bishop, adds what he heard from Tom Adams, a researcher who studied mysterious deaths and mutilations of cattle. According to Adams, Howe visited him a couple of days afterward and was thrilled, "over the moon," about what she had seen. The story matters because, if the documents were real, they would have shown a researcher secret government papers about UFOs.
